sources.snippet: Qwen3.8 ship native MTP (multi-token prediction) head. it predict token t+2 so engine can guess ahead and verify many token in one pass. speculative decoding only go fast when draft head agree with real model. grug retune that head on grug distribution.

sources.title: grug-27b: Text-to-Text model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: Overview grug-27b is a 27-billion-parameter language model built by ProCreations that specializes in dense, efficient reasoning without verbose filler text. It is a LoRA fine-tune (rank 32 on all text-stack linear layers) merged to bfloat16 precision on top of Qwen/Qwen3.6-27B.
